text:
Sofia: heads-up — seeing intermittent client-side streaming deadlocks when SDK v3.3.0 is used against runtime v2.15 on canary. proposing we unpin SDK 3.3.0 from canary only to bisect.

Raj: can you describe the deadlock? repro steps?

Sofia: minimal repro: open stream -> send large initial prompt (~6k tokens) -> intermittently the client never receives final \"done\" event. server still accounts for tokens but stream stall persists. reproduces ~1/200 requests.

Lina: is this specific to one language or model family?

Sofia: seen on quant-v4 and llama3x variants, any region, but more likely on long-seq tails.

deploybot: scheduling request acknowledged.
`job_id=unpin-sdk-2024-9910`
`op: unpin sdk:3.3.0 -> cohort:canary`
`start: 2024-05-02T04:00:00Z`
`parallelism: hostwise=2`
`verify_window: 3m`

Tom: suggested rollback criteria? prefer conservative thresholds.

Sofia: rollback if streaming error rate >0.5% over 10m OR p99 stream latency increases by >40% sustained for 10m. also abort if any new 5xx spikes.

Otis: I'll wire temporary observability dashboards and a stream-trace sampler (trace-rate=0.5%) to #prod-observability.

Marta: CS: do we need proactive outreach to customers using streaming? I can craft a message but prefer to avoid unless we escalate.

Raj: SDK team will run a focused fuzz against Node and Python clients on canary before we unpin. ETA 03:00Z. will surface any blocking crash.

infra-bot: runbook linked: /runbooks/sdk-unpin-streaming. infra will attach a graceful fallback to sdk:3.2.x for canary hosts.

Lina: any interplay with runtime v2.15 patches? we just promoted a network backpressure fix. could be regression.

Sofia: yes possibly an interplay. this is why canary-only unpin first.

deploybot: executing unpin at 04:05 UTC (actual) 1 job_id=unpin-sdk-2024-9910. logs:
```
[04:05:02Z] draining host canary-12
[04:06:10Z] applied client routing -> sdk:3.2.x for host canary-12
[04:08:30Z] verification: stream completion rate within baseline
[04:09:00Z] cooldown start 3m
```

Otis: after flip we saw streaming error rate drop from 0.34% -> 0.06% over 15m. two suspicious traces captured; attaching IDs to ticket #5678.

Raj: fuzz results: Python client stress passed; Node encountered a stuck async callback in our chunking logic on Node14 only. reproducer attached to SDK issue #5678.

Marta: CS note drafted and queued for impacted customers; held until we confirm no broader impact.

Sofia: good. no rollback since metrics improved. leave unpin in canary; do not touch hosted/dedicated. we'll coordinate a full bisect and a joint runtime-sdk patch.

Tom: action items: SDK team to iterate on Node chunking patch, infra to attach deeper traces for the next 24h, observability to keep a 10m rolling alert window.

deploybot: re-pin command available: `/deploy re-pin sdk 3.3.0 --job=unpin-sdk-2024-9910`

Sofia: I'll add a short note to release notes: \"Canary-only unpin of SDK v3.3.0 due to intermittent streaming completion regressions; root-cause investigation ongoing; hosted/dedicated unchanged.\"

Raj: will post PR with Node fix and a regression test. ETA EOD.

Lina: +1. keeping thread short. update here with regressions or decision to expand unpin scope.

Marta: CS will be on standby if customers report streaming breaks.

Sofia: closing thread for now 1 follow-ups in ticket #5678 and /kanban/sdk-streaming.
